question: Which ten-syllabled knowledge is the speaker about to reveal to the listener?
premises: The listener is asked to hear.
The speaker declares an intention to speak.
The subject is the ten-syllabled Tara-vidya.
inference: The speaker is about to reveal the ten-syllabled Tara-vidya to the listener.
plain_english: Hear, dear one; I shall speak to you of the ten-syllabled Tara-vidya.
